image_prompts.prompt: The character-consistent Albertosaurus from the config library crossing the finish line in first place. SUBJECT ANCHOR: Slate-blue skin, navy racing stripes, red-tipped eye crests, and exactly TWO claws per hand. ACTION: He is breaking the finish line tape with his chest in a graceful, upright sprint. He doesn't look tired; he looks perfectly composed and athletic. FACIAL EXPRESSION: A smug, arrogant smirk with half-lidded eyes, looking as if the race was far too easy for him. HANDS: His small two-fingered hands are held near his waist, with the two claws pressed together neatly. SETTING: The finish line of the prehistoric track, with a cheering (blurred) dinosaur crowd in the background. ART STYLE: 'STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3' with sleek, polished forms. LIGHTING: 'SUNNY_EXPOSED_CINEMATIC'. FRAMING: 'SQUARE_HERO_CARD' low-angle shot to make him look heroic and superior.
